text:
eli: quick postmortem follow-up  backup-prune job flooded paging last night (~130 pages in 12m). Majority were repeats; we need a tiny, pragmatic plan with owners and firm dates.

tara: observed ~78% duplicates. Root causes: synchronized retries in the job, low alert threshold, and no upstream collapse.

mike: Proposed actions (i'll take #1):
1) bump prune-fail alert threshold from 2 -> 12 failures/10m. owner: mike. due: 2025-03-05. ticket: SINF-909.
2) ingestion collapse: collapse identical fingerprints for 2m, include total_count & host list. owner: tara. due: 2025-03-03.
3) Alertmanager grouping tweak: group_by ['alertname','task'], group_interval 4m. owner: eli. due: 2025-03-02.
4) scheduled-job silence defaults: auto-silence known cron windows +/-90s. owner: dina. due: 2025-03-01.

dina: i'll add the silence rule to ops-config and include tests. cron is `0 02 * * *` UTC for prune job.

tara: i'll implement dedupe with a feature flag and add unit tests; plan to roll for 48h. we'll preserve a collapsed-count in the alert body.

ops-bot: created SINF-909 - "backup-prune paging noise" -> https://boards.redwood.internal/SINF-909

eli: decision: collapse+count, bump threshold, auto-silence scheduled jobs. scheduling a 15m sync Fri 11:00 UTC to review PRs. If any owner needs to swap or extend dates, reply here.
